item.title: Byte Club — Wednesday, October 7, 2026
item.description: OpenAI 722 math papers/372 results on GitHub (Lean, IAS advisory group); Microsoft+Nvidia Surface Laptop Ultra event (RTX Spark, memory crunch, DGX Spark price hike); NYC Council AI agent hearing (Google 3 test escapes, no lab guarantees safety); Nvidia record $5.65T + SpaceX $40B debt for chips; Meta+Sierra Personal Agent Protocol (Amazon blocked Muse); Apple Oct 13 smart home + LG-branded doorbell/lock/thermostat; Mistral Large 4 "le Chonk" 1T open weights; Google Nano Banana 2.1 half price (NB2 shutdown Oct 29); ShinyHunters "Rey" detained in Jordan; Common Sense Media rates ChatGPT for Teens unacceptable risk. Lightning: Etched $40-50B bids; Finland halts Google data centers; Google 3.6GW Constellation nuclear deal; first US AI music fraud sentence; Micron Taiwan union strike vote. Hype or Legit: local AI-agent laptops.
